title: Directory
description: A dated, retrievable package of a publisher's whole organizational structure.

@type.description: Always `DataFeed`. Without this an org chart is only a pile of files with no statement of what the set contains, when it was current, or who stands behind it - a consumer polls one URL and can tell whether anything changed.

description.description: A plain-language description of what this directory covers.

url.description: Where this directory can be retrieved.

publisher.description: The `GovernmentOrganization` asserting this directory. Required: an unattributed directory cannot be trusted or corrected.

dateModified.description: When the directory last changed. Required, and the field a polling consumer reads first.

conformanceLevel.description: schemaGov conformance level claimed, per SPEC section 4. Distinct from `conformsTo`, which names an external standard the data follows.

numberOfItems.description: How many entities this directory contains.

dataFeedElement.description: References to every entity in the directory. References, never inlined copies - see SPEC section 1.2.

license.description: The license this directory is published under.

inLanguage.description: The language(s) this directory is published in.
